milestone <63 new common sessions: integrity only, no performance claim
milestone 126 sessions: early observation only, no final pass/fail
milestone 252 sessions: provisional report only, no product promotion based on this milestone alone

at primary decision at least 100 sessions must have positive frozen V11 sp500 target exposure; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_ROLE_EXPOSURE
primary: candidate cumulative/annualized return > V11 control over the exact common prospective window
primary: candidate Sharpe >= V11 control Sharpe over the exact common prospective window
primary: paired circular moving-block bootstrap with 63-session blocks and 20000 replicates gives P(candidate CAGR > V11 CAGR) >=0.90
primary: bootstrap median candidate-minus-V11 CAGR delta >0
